title: Disclaimer
excerpt: Financial, medical and legal results are estimates — here is exactly what that means.
content:
Every calculator on this site is an estimate built from a documented formula. This page says, plainly, where the limits are.

Money

Loan, mortgage, investment and tax calculators reproduce standard formulas. Real statements differ: interest accrues on your lender's schedule, fees are charged in ways the formula cannot see, and tax rules change and depend on where you live. Treat the output as a planning figure and compare it with an official statement before committing to anything.

Health

Health calculators (BMI, dosage, pregnancy dates, risk scores) are educational. They use population-level formulas, not your individual clinical picture. They are not a diagnosis, a prescription or a substitute for a clinician who has examined you.

Engineering, construction and safety

Material, structural and electrical calculators give estimates from simplified models. Loads, tolerances and codes vary by jurisdiction and by product. Anything that bears weight, conducts current or holds back water needs a qualified professional and the manufacturer's data.

No professional relationship

Using this site does not create a professional relationship of any kind. No result here constitutes financial, legal, medical or engineering advice.
meta_description: What the results on this site are and are not: estimates that need checking against a professional or a primary source.
